protections_menuTitle.title: Protections Report

protections_statsSwitchTitle.title: Summary

protections_activitySwitchTitle.title: Details

protections_noRecent.title: No recent tracking activity
protections_noRecent.note: Placeholder text shown in the Details view when no tracking activity was blocked in the last 7 days. Keep concise if possible.

protections_report_infoLabel.title: Why this matters

protections_report_infoTitle.title: Why this matters
protections_report_infoTitle.note: Title of the pop-over explaining why tracker blocking matters.

protections_report_infoBody1.title: Trackers aren’t just on sensitive sites. They’re on the news you read, the recipes you save, the stores you browse, and more. And they’re quietly piecing it all together into a detailed (and frankly, creepy!) profile of you.
protections_report_infoBody1.note: First paragraph of the 'Why this matters' pop-over.

protections_report_infoBody2.title: The more of your everyday browsing happens on DuckDuckGo, the less of it they get to see.
protections_report_infoBody2.note: Second paragraph of the 'Why this matters' pop-over.
